findings.detail: MemoryReviewSession does not single-flight reads against a server that admits only one command per profile. refresh() only treats busy as blocking when more is true (and the Refresh button stays enabled during list/preview), and select() allows another preview while busy==='preview'. A second GET hits busy while the first success is dropped by the revision guard, so a valid page/preview is discarded and the UI stores the busy/unavailable error.
findings.fix: Serialize session HTTP: refuse refresh/select/start while deciding or busy, disable those controls whenever busy is set, and do not bump revision for a call that did not start.

findings.detail: The session's 15s request timeout is shorter than the helper's 20s deadline, and handle() does not take a client abort. A slow decide is failed in the UI while the helper is still running; the catch path immediately lists, gets busy, and readPage's error path sets missing=!!selectedId even though the item was not shown to be gone. That hides Apply/Reject/Resume behind “Refresh saved reviews…” and reports unknownResult/unavailable for an in-flight CAS.
findings.fix: Keep the client timeout above validateRuntime plus the helper deadline (or abort the helper on client timeout and map in-flight decide to recovery-required). On list failure after decide, do not set missing; keep the item uncertain and retry list after the in-flight decide drain.

findings.detail: After a decide helper returns, run() still fail('stale-review') if options.context() identity changed, and fail('unavailable') if stdout is not a strict {ok,result} envelope (including JSON/UTF-8 parse failure in runMemoryReviewHelper on exit 0). Those paths can fire after the helper has already applied/rejected. stale-review then causes the UI to list the new context, which may not be the store that was mutated, so the applied result is not confirmed and looks like a failed review.
findings.fix: Once decide has been sent to the helper, do not classify outcomes as stale-review/unavailable: return a parsed MemoryReviewDecision, or fail('recovery-required'). Keep the pre-invoke identity check so a decide is not started on a different profile.
